• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.employer_name: ZOE Institute for Future-Fit Economies gUG
jobs.description:
Who we are

ZOE, the Institute for Future-Fit Economies, is an independent think & do tank active in Germany and in Brussels . We are dedicated to policy-oriented research and evidence-driven advocacy for a futurefit economy. At the interface of politics, research, and civil society in the EU, we develop impulses for an economy that enables people to live well within planetary boundaries.

We offer:

- A motivating working environment in a small think & do tank that has become an established actor in Brussels in a short space of time
- A strategic, agile, value and purpose-oriented working style
- Flexibility of working time and place, supporting a healthy work-life-balance

The role

The Economics of a Green and Just Transition team is seeking a trainee to support policy and research work across several projects related to financing and implementing a green and just transition. The trainee will help develop content and analytical materials, contribute to EU-level policy analysis, and may also support an industry-focused project with a particular emphasis on Germany.

Key responsibilities

As part of a motivated and impact-driven team you will carry out a variety of tasks, including: − Background research and analysis on various topics

- Drafting content for reports, policy briefs and other publications
- Preparation of presentations and key documents
- Preparing briefings for key stakeholder meetings
- Support in monitoring of current economic policy events and debates
- Support in the organization of events (physical and online)

Core competences

We are looking for people that share our core principles: value orientation, sustainability, agility, selforganisation .

Your profile would include the following skills, background , and knowledge:

- Excellent command of English and German , both oral and written -
- Master’s degree in economics/ political economy /European studies /public policy
- Interest in economic policy topics like fiscal policy and industrial policy
- Ability to work independently and in teams
- Strong analytical skills
- Strategic mindset

In addition, some of the following competencies fit well into our team but are not a requirement: -

- Knowledge of legislative processes in the EU and/or Germany
- Qualitative and/or quantitative research skills
- Based in Brussels or Berlin

Conditions

We are looking for someone to join our team for 38 hours per week for 6 months. The position will start ideally in October 2026. We offer the possibility to work remotely from Germany , the Netherlands, or Belgium or to work from our offices in Cologne, Berlin, and Brussels.

The gross monthly salary for full-time is 2289 euros, prorated for fewer hours. The remuneration for this position is based on our internal salary framework, informed by the collective agreement of the public service of the Länder. For a full-time (38 hours) position, 30 holiday days are offered for one calendar year.

In addition to this, ZOE offers several benefits such as additional days off for volunteering and reimbursement for public transportation.

Diversity

We believe that our society’s behaviour disproportionately hurts the most marginali sed people – including people of colour, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women and LGBTIQ people. We are committed to challenge this through our work for socially just development and by creating a diverse workplace at our organisation . Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people who are members of marginali sed communities.

Application procedure

Please send your applications by 30 August. Please send : a) your CV (max 3 pages), b) a motivation letter (400–500 words) explaining why you would like to work with ZOE Institute and c) a sample of your work (power point slides, publication, press release or similar) to applications@zoe-institut.de. Please do not attach a photo to your application. Please state “Economic Policy Trainee” in the subject line.
If we shortlist you for an interview, we will get back to you as soon as possible with dates for an online interview. In case of any questions please contact applications@zoe-institut.de. Thank you very much for your interest in ZOE Institute .

This SAP position centers on production-driven processes in a manufacturing setting, with a clear focus on SAP PE, QM and PPDS.

You take the lead in and support end-to-end SAP implementations, covering fit-gap analysis, system configuration, functional design documentation, training, UAT, data gathering and migration, go-live support, and final documentation. In this role, you work closely with logistics, controlling, procurement and other business domains to secure smooth SAP integration across domains.

You collaborate proactively with cross-functional stakeholders and production team members to shape detailed, scalable and sustainable processes. This assignment calls for someone who can grasp complex business flows, challenge stakeholders to clarify their real needs, and translate those requirements into structured SAP solutions in both template-based and custom-built environments.

You also support business users through clear communication, maintain alignment between domains, and contribute to successful deployment activities in an international environment.

Key responsibilities

• Lead and support SAP delivery across the full implementation lifecycle, from analysis through go-live and documentation.
• Design and optimize production-related SAP processes within a manufacturing environment.
• Translate business needs into robust functional solutions across connected SAP domains.
• Work with stakeholders across logistics, controlling, procurement and production to ensure process consistency and integration.
• Support deployment activities, including additional travel where needed around go-live periods.
Project scope

• Production Execution (PE): strong expertise in SAP PE processes in a manufacturing context, including shop floor integration and execution flows.
• Quality Management (QM): solid experience in SAP QM, ideally combined with integration with Labvantage or a comparable LIMS platform.
• PPDS: good understanding of Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling, with the ability to connect planning and execution processes.
• Experience with EWM integration is an advantage.
• Experience in greenfield implementations is a plus.
Work environment

You work in an international, multicultural setting with regular on-site presence in Hoboken and travel when required, including possible additional travel during go-live phases.

• Proven experience with end-to-end SAP implementations.
• Strong expertise in SAP integration across domains, including logistics, controlling and procurement.
• Hands-on experience with SAP PE, QM and PPDS in a manufacturing company.
• PPDS knowledge is preferred but not mandatory.
• Familiarity with integration with Labvantage or a similar LIMS platform, and preferably EWM.
• Ability to debug and troubleshoot SAP issues is a plus.
• You communicate clearly, in a structured and business-oriented way, and can explain complex solutions in a simple manner to stakeholders.
• You are comfortable challenging the business to uncover the underlying requirements.
• You collaborate effectively with both business stakeholders and technical colleagues and build strong working relationships.
• You demonstrate a proactive mindset, resilience under pressure and flexibility when priorities shift.
• You are willing to be on site in Hoboken every week.

• Polish is a plus.
• A bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• SAP certification is an asset, but hands-on experience is considered more important.

• Managing human and financial resources efficiently within the allocated budgets while meeting the city's KPI’s.
• Coaching, motivating, and guiding the team to perform at their maximum potential, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities.
• Maintaining a strong and proactive network of relationships with the financing government, local stakeholders, and various players within the industry.
• Reporting on operations and milestones to the Executive Board.

Simultaneously, you showcase local successes and act as the public face of the organization fostering the local public relations (PR), translating achievements into pride for the city and local stakeholders. 
• Leading the day-to-day management and further development of the organisation in line with the long-term strategy, ensuring the implementation of clear procedures, best practices, and an optimal organisational structure.

You are first and foremost an organisation builder and a true people manager who provides your team with direction, clarity, and structure. Additionally, you are a business-minded networker who effortlessly represents the organisation and inspires others during presentations and networking events. You possess a strategic approach paired with innovative thinking, and you show great diplomatic sensitivity towards the interests of local stakeholders.
Additionally, you possess:

• A Master’s degree (or equivalent working and thinking level), coupled with substantial experience in setting up, structuring, and leading a solid organisation at a senior management level.
• Strong PR skills and a proven track record of local stakeholder management, successfully communicating results to government, partners, ambassadors, the team and other stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium

• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

Shape the architecture behind the next generation of AI supercomputers.
 

Join imec and design the future of AI computing
 

What if your architectural decisions could influence the future of artificial intelligence at the scale of the world's most advanced computing systems?

Together with leading experts in computing systems, chip technology, software, and artificial intelligence, you will help define how future AI infrastructure is built, optimized, and scaled.

This is not a product maintenance role. It is an opportunity to explore breakthrough architectures that could shape the next decade of AI and high-performance computing.
 

What you will do
 

As a Principal AI & High-Performance Computing Architect, you will drive innovation across the entire computing stack, from AI applications and system software to processors, accelerators, and semiconductor technologies.

You will create models, simulations, and design explorations that help identify the most promising paths toward future AI computing systems that deliver significant improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and sustainability.

• Exploring architectural solutions for next-generation AI and high-performance computing clusters.

• Developing performance models that identify bottlenecks and opportunities for innovation. 

• Evaluating future processor, accelerator, memory, and system designs. 

• Collaborating with experts in computer architecture, AI, semiconductor technology, system software, and modelling. 

• Defining requirements for future AI computing platforms and processor architectures. 

• Guiding strategic research directions through data-driven performance analysis and projections. 

• Contributing to breakthrough innovations that improve performance, energy efficiency, operational cost, and environmental impact. 

Who you are
 
 

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant STEM degree, with at least around 8 years of experience.   

• Experience with performance analysis, engineering, and optimization of HPC applications, such as molecular dynamics and computational fluid dynamics,  

• Experience in AI for HPC is a plus.   

• Experience with distributed AI/ML applications, such as LLM training and inference.   

• Experience in system performance modeling ranging from a single device (e.g. a GPU) to a machine scale (e.g. a cluster).  

• Good understanding of GPU (preferably XPU) system architectures, distributed programming models, runtime resource management, and microarchitecture.   

• Strong programming ability in C++ and Python. CUDA knowledge is considered a plus.   

• Your communication and interpersonal skills enable you to work in a dynamic, distributed team. You actively share experiences and knowledge with colleagues. A history of mentoring more junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.

jobs.occupation: Junior Associate, Battery Passport & Sustainability Benchmarks M/W/X
jobs.description:
The Junior Associate will provide analytical and coordination support to the Battery Passport programme, with a particular focus on the Battery Benchmarks sustainability framework. The role combines standards and regulatory research, consultation analysis, drafting, data organisation and practical support to working groups, governance meetings and operations. 

This is a hands-on junior role in a small, internationally oriented team. It requires comfort moving between technical sustainability content, data handling and processing, and routine delivery tasks, including meeting administration, document control, stakeholder follow-up and event logistics. 

Key responsibilities 

Battery Benchmarks development 

• Analyse, catalogue and synthesise feedback from GBA member and public consultations. 
• Map voluntary ESG and responsible-sourcing standards relevant to battery and critical-mineral value chains. 
• Maintain regulatory and standards mappings and propose evidence-based updates to Battery Benchmarks modules and supporting documentation. 
• Support development of thematic modules. 
Assurance and credibility 

• Conduct background research on data assurance, verification, conformity assessment and certification approaches relevant to the Battery Passport. 
• Prepare comparisons, notes and materials for review by programme leads and external experts. 
Consultation and capacity building 

• Support the design and delivery of consultation surveys, webinars, outreach materials and the analysis of responses. 
• Draft and organise capacity-building and e-learning content using existing GBA frameworks and technical source material. 
Policy and regulatory monitoring 

• Monitor developments affecting batteries, critical minerals, sustainability reporting and responsible sourcing, and maintain a structured regulatory tracker. 
• Draft concise internal summaries and, where requested, first drafts of policy-facing materials. 
Working-group and Secretariat support 

• Prepare agendas, slide materials, minutes, action logs and member-input records for working groups, steering committees and governance meetings. 
• Support member-management processes, mailing lists, document repositories, event preparation, on-site delivery and post-event reporting. 
• Synthesise publications and market information into briefs, web copy or social-media drafts, and undertake other reasonable Secretariat tasks as required. 
• Excellent verbal and written communications in a culturally diverse and politically sensitive environment. 
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement AI-enabled workflows, including task-specific agents, to improve data handling, optimise internal processes, and support the ongoing maintenance of GBA standards and regulatory mappings.  
Required qualifications and experience 

• A completed master's degree in sustainable development, environmental policy or governance, international development, sustainability management, responsible business, supply-chain governance, or a closely related field. 
• Demonstrable professional experience analysing sustainability or ESG standards, regulatory frameworks and responsible-sourcing requirements in complex value chains. 
• Demonstrable research familiarity with battery or critical-mineral value chains, or with a closely comparable global industrial supply chain involving material environmental and human-rights risks. 
• Experience organising and analysing qualitative and quantitative information, including structured datasets, document review and synthesis of stakeholder input. 
• Ability to turn complex technical or policy material into accurate, concise written outputs for non-specialist and specialist audiences. 
• Strong organisational discipline, including document management, meeting preparation, minute-taking and follow-through on actions and deadlines. 
• Professional fluency in written and spoken English. 
• Ability to work from Brussels and to participate in occasional early-morning or late-afternoon international meetings; willingness to travel occasionally for GBA events. 
• The successful candidate must be legally entitled to work in Belgium before commencing employment. 
• Demonstrated experience using AI and data-analysis tools to develop efficient workflows, manage and interpret complex datasets, and support the ongoing maintenance of standards and regulatory frameworks. 
 

Desirable qualifications 

• Working knowledge of the EU Batteries Regulation and one or more relevant sustainability or reporting frameworks (for example GRI, ESRS/CSRD, responsible-minerals due diligence standards, EcoVadis or life-cycle assessment approaches). 
• Experience with stakeholder consultations, multi-stakeholder initiatives or expert workshops. 
• Applied capability in Excel and at least one data-analysis or visualisation tool such as Power BI, R or GIS. 
• Experience with collaborative platforms such as Microsoft 365, Teams and SharePoint. 
• Working knowledge of French or another language relevant to GBA's international stakeholder base. 
• Experience using carefully governed AI-assisted research or monitoring tools, with appropriate source checking and data-handling discipline.  
Working arrangements 

• The role is based in Brussels and involves close collaboration with a small Secretariat and external technical advisers. 
• Workload will vary with consultation, governance and event deadlines. Administrative and coordination work is an integral part of the position, not an incidental duty. 
• Some meetings are scheduled across international time zones, and occasional travel or on-site event support may be required.

Our analytics estate runs on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI: hundreds of workspaces, a large self-service community, and a regulated environment where access control, traceability and data integrity are not optional.

The platform is also moving fast. Copilot and data agents put generative AI in front of business users, Fabric IQ adds an ontology- based semantic layer, and Fabric Apps turn workspaces into a home for real, write-enabled applications each with its own tenant settings, capacity cost and compliance question. Someone has to decide how they get switched on, for whom, and under which controls.

We are looking for an administrator who treats the platform as a product: someone who automates rather than clicks, who can tell you exactly which capacity is throttling and why, and who keeps a GxP-relevant estate auditable without becoming a bottleneck for the business. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a ticket queue.

Responsibilities

 
• Tenant & capacity administration:
  
   
• Tenant settings, domains, workspaces, capacities (F Skus) and delegated capacity settings.
   
• Capacity health and cost: smoothing, bursting, throttling, background vs. interactive operations. Right-size, forecast, and support chargeback to business units.
   
• Onelake, deployment pipelines, GIT integration and CI/CD for Fabric items (Fabric-CICD, Fabric REST APIs).
   
• On-premises and VNET GateWay clusters, connections, and service principal / workspace identity access to source systems (SNOW, Veeva, Edp, ERP).
   
• Incident response and root-cause analysis on refresh failures, performance degradation and access issues; evaluation of preview features before they reach users.
  
 
• Automation & monitoring, the core of this job:
  
   
• Fuam (Fabric Unified Admin Monitoring) as the backbone of tenant observability: deploy it, keep it current with upstream releases, extend it, and turn its output into operational decisions.
   
• Administration automated with PowerShell (Microsoftpowerbimgmt, AZ, Microsoft.Graph) and Python (semantic-link-labs, notebooks) against the Admin, Scanner and REST APIs: provisioning, access reviews, orphaned-item cleanup, licence reclamation, tenant-setting drift detection.
   
• That automation runs properly, Azure DevOps pipelines, Azure Automation/Functions with logging, alerting and error handling.
   
• Observability beyond Fuam where needed: Workspace Monitoring (Eventhouse), Log Analytics, Capacity Metrics, Purview Audit.
  
 
• AI & new workloads:
  
   
• Copilot configuration: the Copilot and Azure Openai Service tenant settings, delegation to capacity administrators, security- group scoping, and the data-residency choices behind them.
   
• The cost of AI: Copilot and agents bill against capacity, so track Cu impact and assess whether a dedicated Fabric Copilot capacity makes sense.
   
• Fabric data agents: who may build them, on which sources, how they are validated, and what changes when they are surfaced through Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or MCP.
   
• Fabric IQ readiness (Ontology, graph, agents) and administration of Fabric Apps workload enablement, operational vs. data apps, the Rayfin CLI, and a review path for anything that writes data back.
  
 
• Governance & compliance:
  
   
• The workspace, domain and naming model, and the promotion path from self-service sandbox to certified content.
   
• Access through Entra ID groups and service principals: least privilege, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews and recertification.
   
• Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and DLP across Fabric and Power BI items.
   
• Qualification and validation...
  
...

• Hands-on PowerShell & Python automation using Fabric Admin/REST APIs, Microsoft Graph and Microsoftpowerbimgmt

jobs.description:
As a Bio Process Technician at BBEPP, you choose a job that is truly different. You will work with a team of engineers and technicians on a wide variety of innovative projects. No routine work, but an inspiring environment where you gain new insights, deepen your expertise, and further develop your talents. Together with your colleagues, you scale up and optimize bio-based processes (from lab to industrial scale) that contribute to a sustainable bio-economy and to solutions for today’s and tomorrow’s climate challenges.

In the role of a Bio Process Technician, you are responsible for preparing processes and setting up (pre-) industrial pilot installations. In addition to setting up these test installations, you will also carry out the different process steps and operate the corresponding equipment. In consultation with the process engineers, you closely monitor the process parameters of the scale-up processes assigned to you (fermentation, biocatalysis, purification). You regularly take samples, analyse them in the lab, and critically evaluate the results, actively contributing ideas for potential improvements. Moreover, you act as a true ambassador for safety, structure, and hygiene in the process environment.

We're looking for a motivated weekend employee (2 x 12-hour nights per week + 2 x 8-hour days per month). You're a hands-on technician with a no-nonsense mentality who enjoys actively participating in innovative bio-based processes.

You work independently, methodically, and accurately, and you have knowledge of biotechnological processes such as fermentation or biocatalysis, or experience in process industry, chemistry, or food. Experience with bio-based products and processes is a plus. You are a real team player and communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.

The ideal candidate holds a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, HBO5 chemistry/biochemistry, or a laboratory technician diploma. In this case, previous work experience is not required. If you already have experience in the process industry, chemistry, or food sector, an A2 diploma (secondary education) in a scientific or technical field is also sufficient.

Nobody is perfect, at Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant, there is plenty of room to learn by doing! Can’t check every box above, but are you flexible, eager to learn, and open to tailored training? Do you enjoy taking on challenges, with a healthy dose of pioneer spirit running through your veins? Then don’t hesitate to get in touch!

The Office Manager ensures the smooth daily operation of the shopping centre through administrative management, coordination with internal teams and tenants, and professional reception of visitors. They support management with reporting, agenda management and information handling, while maintaining accurate records and ensuring efficient communication across the site.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day‑to‑day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

 

Omschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow‑up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision‑making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

 

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands‑on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping‑centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time‑management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

jobs.description:

With more than 200 points of sale and over 2,000 employees, the company is continuing its international growth, driven by innovation, operational excellence and a strong commitment to customer experience.

Joining this organisation means becoming part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial international group where digital transformation and customer-centricity are at the heart of the growth strategy.

As E-commerce & Digital Experience Specialist , you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the company e-commerce platforms.

Working at the crossroads of e-commerce, digital performance, IT and customer experience, you will monitor platform performance, coordinate incidents, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute to the implementation of new digital functionalities.

• Monitor the daily performance and operational KPIs of the Benelux e-commerce platforms, ensuring a smooth and reliable online customer experience.

• Investigate root causes, recommend corrective actions and drive continuous improvements across processes and tools.
• Take ownership of the quality of the Dutch-language Belgian webshop, reviewing content, translations and the end-to-end customer journey.
• Analyse digital performance, user behaviour and customer data to identify opportunities to improve conversion, usability and overall experience.
• Set up, monitor and analyse A/B tests and translate insights into concrete optimisation initiatives.
• Contribute to the delivery of new digital functionalities, from gathering business requirements and functional analysis through testing and release validation.
• Manage and prioritise the e-commerce backlog in close collaboration with Group Project and IT teams.
• Support the implementation of new marketing, personalisation and digital optimisation tools.
• Collaborate with Benelux and Group teams to share best practices and contribute to the broader international digital roadmap.

• Native or near-native Dutch speaker, with an excellent understanding of the Dutch language and strong attention to linguistic and content quality.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in E-Business, Digital Marketing, Business IT or a related field.
• At least 4 years of experience in e-commerce, digital operations, web operations or a comparable role.
• Strong understanding of e-commerce operations, digital performance and customer journey optimisation.
• Experience in an omnichannel, retail or international environment is highly valued.
• Good command of French and professional proficiency in English.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and insights into actionable improvements.
• Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Comfortable working across business and technical teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders.

• Curious, proactive and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and a genuine interest in digital innovation.

We're partnered with a large textiles business looking to expand with a new Scrum Master. As AI agents become active participants in the development process - writing, testing, and refactoring code alongside human engineers - the way teams plan, collaborate, and deliver is changing fast.

We are looking for a Scrum Master who thrives in that kind of shift: someone who can hold onto the core of what makes agile teams effective, while being genuinely curious and hands-on about reshaping it for a new way of working.

This isn't a role for someone looking to run ceremonies by the book. It's for someone who wants to help two teams, based in different countries, figure out together what agile looks like when part of the "team" doesn't sleep, doesn't take breaks, and works at a completely different rhythm than the humans around it.
What the role involves

• Facilitating the core Scrum ceremonies - sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives - across two geographically distributed teams, keeping collaboration strong despite the distance

• Rethinking familiar rituals for a new context: when AI agents are completing work continuously rather than in daily human blocks, what does a "daily stand-up" even MEAN? The successful candidate will help the team find out

• Guiding the team through new questions around estimation, velocity, and "done" - questions that don't have settled answers yet, given how differently AI-driven work behaves compared to traditional development

• Supporting developers through a real shift in their day-to-day role: from writing every line of code themselves to defining intent clearly, reviewing and validating what agents produce, and overseeing agentic workflows responsibly

• Building a culture where experimentation is normal and continuous improvement isn't just a retrospective exercise - because the tools and best practices in this space are moving quickly, and the team's process needs to move with them

• Clearing a path for the team by removing blockers, including ones unique to this environment: agent permissions and access, infrastructure limitations, or specification quality issues that trip up automated work

• Working closely with Product Ownership to make sure backlog items are written with enough clarity and testability that both human developers and AI agents can act on them without ambiguity

• Tracking delivery in a way that actually reflects reality - recognising that familiar metrics like story points or lines of code may not tell the full story anymore, and helping the team find better ones

• Building genuine trust and shared practice between the two country-based teams, so that both are working from the same playbook and learning from each other as agentic workflows evolve

• Solid, proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach within a software development environment - enterprise or B2B software experience is a strong plus

• Real, practical familiarity with agentic software development: AI systems that can autonomously plan, write, and test code, not just autocomplete-style tooling

• A clear grasp of how AI-assisted and AI-driven development is reshaping developer workflows, code review, testing, and quality practices

• Genuine comfort with ambiguity and fast-moving change, with a track record of adapting process pragmatically rather than defending a textbook framework for its own sake

• Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills - the human side of this role matters just as much as the technical awareness

• A recognised Scrum Master certification, though the client sees this as a starting point rather than the full picture - this role asks for more than the standard curriculum covers

• Professional fluency in both Dutch and English

 

Nice to have:

• Direct experience working with AI coding agents or AI-augmented development pipelines in a live production setting

• A background in change management, especially leading teams through significant shifts in tooling or process

 

The kind of person you are (beyond the CV):

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business  

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Czech and Polish.

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. A solid technical understanding matters, but your impact will come through coaching, collaboration, and delivery rather than hands-on implementation.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Keep enough depth in our stack (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services) to contribute to architectural discussions and understand the challenges your team faces. Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

jobs.occupation: Junior Researcher on Multi-Agent Collaboration for Autonomous Ground Systems (iMUGS2) M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT

You work within the Robotics & Autonomous Systems (https://mecatron.rma.ac.be/) research unit of the department of Mechanics of the Polytechnic Faculty of the RMA. You conduct scientific research at university level on a project entitled ¿iMUGS2¿.Your research will focus on the application of Multi-Agent Collaboration technology for collaborative autonomy in unmanned ground systems, including:

• Develop an interoperable, open, and modular multi-agent architecture in the global architecture of the project's System-of-Systems
• Study and integration of optimal multi-robot planning algorithms
• Define communication interface to enable the exchange of information between the team
 

Given the applied nature of this project and its strong involvement in European-scale collaborative defence programs, you will occasionally prepare and participate in on-site demonstrations and field trials, mainly on military sites in Europe.

 

MAIN TASKS

• Research/prototype multi-agent collaborative autonomy solutions for unmanned ground systems.
• Support development and implementation of standards that enable interoperability, focusing on mission management and multi-agent autonomy.
• Contribute to the integration with ROS/ROS2 of the developed solutions in real vehicles.
• Participate in testing, validation, and demonstration campaigns.
• Document your research and contribute to scientific publications, deliverables, and project reports. 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree(s) required / ideal degree(s): Master/Engineer's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or related fields

This position is open for junior profiles (ideally 0-3 years of experience) or experienced profiles (up to 10 years of experience.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Excellent oral & written knowledge of English
• Experience in Robotics and knowledge in ROS/ROS2
• 
Good programming skills in Python and/or C++

 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills: 

• Experience in Multi-Agent Collaboration, or multimodal AI
• Knowledge in simulation environments for robotics
• Knowledge in robotics and/or software architecture design
• Knowledge in interoperability, standardisation and/or, more specifically, NATO STANAG/STANREC standards
• Experience in organising tests and demonstrations
• Minimum knowledge of French or Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers.
Personal skills:

• Ability to work independently and in a multi-disciplinary, international team
• You will be working closely together with multiple industrial and academic partners and will get insight in their proprietary intellectual property. Confidentiality is therefore an absolute must.
• You are comfortable working in a complex international, multi-partner environment, fostering constructive collaboration, and resolving interpersonal tensions when needed.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European or NATO projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: From 15 November 2026, in consultation with the applicant. 
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours/week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• Please note that your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to the funding project, which is guaranteed until November 2028 (end of iMUGS2 project). There is a high chance for the project to be prolonged after this initial period, depending on the availability of new funding. 
• Wage scale: class NA11 (holder of a Master's degree in Science or equivalent), or NA21 (holder of an Ir degree or equivalent Master's in Engineering Sciences, doctor's degree in the same area of expertise), with valuable / relevant seniority.  A salary simulation can be done here: Simulateur de salaire. RMA applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations.
• 
Holiday pay.

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day);
• Digital allowance: 15€ / month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max);
• Holidays: 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years) & 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

About Tiense Suikerraffinaderij
For nearly 200 years, Tiense Suikerraffinaderij has been producing sugar from local sugar beets, serving both industries and home kitchens. You'll become part of a family of 600 proud sugar makers who stick together, both on and off the factory floor. They operate with a refined blend of tradition and innovation, aiming for minimal environmental impact as nothing from our sugar beets goes to waste. Our mission? To make life sweeter for people worldwide. And we're excited to do it together with you!

Jobomschrijving

Sweet Challenges Await: Join Our Headquarters in Tienen 
Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

• Flexibility and curiosity – We continue to invest in better, more sustainable and more efficient ways of working. As we modernise our processes and equipment, your expertise and ideas will help us make the right choices and drive continuous improvement.
• Technology and common sense – You'll work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where data, experience and common sense go hand in hand. By gaining insight into manufacturing costs and collaborating with colleagues across departments, you'll help turn insights into practical improvements.
• Solo and as a team – You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and the freedom to take ownership of your work. At the same time, you'll be part of a collaborative environment where teams support one another and work together towards shared goals.
You should also possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Master's Degree (e.g. economics)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business/operational controlling or in an analyst function
• A strong affinity with IT tools: 
• knowledge of Excel including pivot tables is essential
• experience in creating reports and dashboards with a modern tool set is required 
• knowledge of SAP FiCo / SAP BI is an asset 
• Excellent level of spoken and written Dutch and English; good level of French
• Strong competencies in and interest for business analytics, as well as a good understanding of accounting
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach

Training & Knowledge Transfer

Language Skills

Wygwam, a division of the Niko Group, is continuing to build and strengthen its own organization. To support our customers and sales activities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and France, we are looking for a Sales Business Supporter.
 

These are newly created positions that offer the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. During your onboarding, you will work closely with colleagues from both Wygwam and our parent company to gain a thorough understanding of our customers, systems, and processes. Once this foundation is established, you will play an important role in improving the way we work and helping to build a future-proof support organization.
 

As a Sales Business Supporter, you will be a key link between customers and internal departments such as Sales, Operations, Finance, and Logistics. You will support the complete customer journey, combining customer service, commercial support, process coordination, and administrative follow-up. Your contribution will help ensure excellent customer experience while supporting efficient business operations.
 

In this role, you will work in an international environment with colleagues from several European countries. You will report to a manager based in Denmark and collaborate with stakeholders throughout the organization. If you enjoy taking ownership, working across different functions, and contributing to a business undergoing transformation, this could be the perfect next step in your career.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Support end-to-end customer and sales processes across Belgium, the Netherlands, and France. 

• Handle daily customer inquiries and provide professional follow-up through the appropriate communication channels. 

• Process customer orders accurately and ensure timely administrative follow-up. 

• Manage customer returns and coordinate with relevant internal departments to ensure efficient resolution. 

• Maintain customer, product, and pricing information in SAP and ensure data accuracy at all times. 

• Manage commercial agreements, pricing structures, and bonus schemes in accordance with company guidelines. 

• Monitor delivery performance and support the resolution of delivery-related issues when required. 

• Act as the primary link between customers and internal stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Logistics. 

• Support product launches, pricing updates, and future SAP-related developments. 

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to the implementation of more efficient ways of working. 

• Work accurately with data across multiple systems while maintaining a high standard of quality and consistency. 

• Ensure customers receive a professional, timely, and positive experience in every interaction with Wygwam. 

• Collaborate closely with colleagues across departments and countries to achieve shared objectives. 

• Participate actively in meetings, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities throughout the organization.  

 

 

• You have experience in Sales Support, Customer Service, Operations, Business Support, or a similar commercial role. 

• You are fluent in Dutch and French, both spoken and written. 

• You have a professional level of English and can communicate confidently in an international environment. 

• You enjoy taking ownership and consistently follow tasks through to completion. 

• You are comfortable working in a changing environment where priorities may shift. 

• You have a structured and organized way of working with strong attention to detail. 

• You have a customer-focused mindset and enjoy building positive relationships with customers and colleagues. 

• You are proactive and solution-oriented, always looking for opportunities to improve processes. 

• You are resilient and motivated by the challenge of helping build new ways of working while learning from existing processes. 

• You have a good understanding of business processes and administrative workflows. 

• You are confident working with data and managing information across multiple systems. 

• You have strong Excel skills and are comfortable working with the wider Microsoft Office suite. 

• Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is considered a strong advantage. 

• You enjoy collaborating across different functions and working with diverse teams.

Wygwam, a division of the Niko Group, is dedicated to delivering innovative and intelligent electrical solutions for modern buildings. We work closely with architects, consultants, and installers, to integrate technology seamlessly into architectural concepts and functional environments. Both Niko Home Control as our lighting control portfolio belong to your responsibility.

For this role, we are looking for two electricians or hands on specialists who are ready to take the next step in their career and move into a more project-based and commercially oriented pre-sales role. Your electrical experience and interest in building technology will help you understand customer needs, interpret technical information and translate it into accurate project proposals and quotations.
 

The pre-sales technicians we are looking for are responsible for preparing project proposals and quotations for customers, based on information gathered from tenders, customer requests and input from sales colleagues. You’ll work across the relevant product groups within the Wygwam portfolio and play a key role in ensuring customers receive accurate, clear and timely project support.
 

In this role, you’ll handle project-related customer inquiries through different channels, mainly by phone and email. You’ll make sure every request is followed professionally, within the agreed deadlines, and with a strong focus on quality, accuracy and customer satisfaction. To achieve this, you’ll work closely with colleagues in sales, technical teams and other internal departments.
 
 

• Create project proposals for customers based on tenders, customer input and information gathered from sales colleagues. 

• Prepare quotations based on approved project proposals, as well as direct requests from wholesalers, customers or colleagues. 

• Handle customer inquiries related to project support through relevant channels, mainly by phone and email. 

• Maintain project mailboxes and ensure every customer receives a reply within 24 hours. 

• Follow up customer requests within the agreed deadline and take action when another solution is needed. 

• Register all relevant data in the CRM system. 

• Save and organize all relevant project documentation according to the agreed structure. 

• Ensure that every project proposal follows the department guidelines and contains all required information. 

• Keep your calendar up to date with planned project proposals and other relevant tasks to support smooth collaboration with colleagues. 

• Carry out all assignments with a strong focus on quality, accuracy and clear documentation. 

• Work in a structured and systematic way, aiming for error-free results while continuously improving processes and output. 

• Ensure customers have a positive and professional experience in every interaction with Wygwam. 
 

• You have a strong interest or knowledge in building automation and the standards, protocols and technology used. 

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects at the same time without losing overview. 

• You have strong communication skills and can translate technical information into clear explanations for both customers and colleagues. 

• You have a team-oriented mindset and enjoy working closely with sales and technical teams. 

• ·You are customer-focused and proactive in understanding customer needs and providing technically sound solutions. 

• You work accurately and have a strong sense of responsibility for the quality of your work. 

• You are comfortable using standard office software such as Outlook, Excel and Word. 

• You are familiar with digital tools related to daily administrative and project follow-up tasks. 

• You are fluent in Dutch, both spoken and written. 

• You have basic to intermediate knowledge of English, sufficient to understand internal communication and participate in meetings. 

• Fluency in French, both spoken and written, is considered a strong plus.

Who we are 
 

OTIV is a Ghent-based company leading the autonomous revolution in rail. We are on a mission to increase safety and efficiency of railway operations by teaching rail vehicles to drive autonomously. By making trains more efficient and safer, we actively contribute to a modal shift and a greener future. We bring this vision to life by a unique focus on the most challenging environments such as cities, shunting yards and industrial sites. Thanks to high-profile partners and world-leading clients such as Deutsche Bahn, SNCF Group, ArcelorMittal and CAF we deliver the future of railway operations today.
 

 
 

OTIV is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and in which personnel processes are merit-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic. OTIV strives to create an environment in which all employees feel confident in their ability to bring their authentic selves to work and secure collaborating with colleagues and customers.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

Als 
Finance & Admin Specialist neem je ownership over de financiële administratie van OTIV: facturatie, procure-to-pay en ondersteuning bij onze maandelijkse, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen. Naast de cijfers breng je energie en structuur naar onze administratieve backbone: je houdt processen draaiende en mensen ondersteund. Je vormt een sterk team met Marthe (Admin Specialist met focus op People & Operations).
 

Ben jij iemand die detailgericht en samenwerkingsgericht is, onze bedrijfsprocessen met overtuiging wil opnemen, en zowel houdt van de nauwkeurigheid van finance als van de variatie die we te bieden hebben? Apply now!
 

 
 

Tasks and responsibilities
 

As Finance & Admin Specialist at OTIV you will
 

Finance (50%)
 
 

• Book incoming and outgoing invoices and ensure accurate processing 

• Manage the full PO-to-invoice flow 

• Support monthly, quarterly and annual closings together with the accountant 

• Assist in reporting actuals, budget and forecast, and follow up department and company budget 

• Handle payment processing, expenses and record-keeping 

• Administer company insurance matters  

Procurement & logistics
 
 

• Run the full procure-to-pay process: sourcing, receiving, invoicing 

• Place orders with suppliers and follow up to ensure on-time delivery 

• Take ownership of shipments (domestic and international) 

• Maintain accurate records in Odoo, including stock management  

Office & compliance
 
 

• Manage e-inboxes and handle incoming requests 

• Manage client site access, clearances and documentation 

• Administer office onboarding, car park, and PPE 

• Support ISO 9001 processes and audit documentation 

• Provide general administrative support and help coordinate events  

Furthermore, you will form a strong administrative team with Marthe (Admin Specialist with a focus on People & Operations).

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor in accountancy or finance (or equivalent through experience) 

• 3+ years in a financial-administrative role 

• Confident with the numbers: closings, budget follow-up, procure-to-pay, invoicing 

• Hands-on with Odoo or comparable ERP and strong in Excel 

• Genuine passion for office management and general operations: you like keeping things running and people supported 

• Structured, accurate, and able to own end-to-end processes 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• Proactive and pragmatic, thrives in a fast-moving scale-up 

• Affinity with compliance and process improvement 

• Curious about AI and automation: you actively look for ways to streamline and automate administrative and finance processes  

• Fluent in Dutch & English (other languages are a plus)  

Nice to have:
 
 

• Previous experience in a fast-paced & broad administrative team, ideally in a tech or scale-up environment. 

• Experience in international shipping (export documentation,...) 

• Experience in People/HR processes (payroll, ...)

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.

While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.

To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.

The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.

One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.

We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.

Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.

HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.

Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.

External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

Profile

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.

• You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

At Traxial, we are designing the next generation of high-performance, energy-efficient systems. We’re looking for a PE & Motor Control Engineer to join our innovative team and play a pivotal role in creating systems that push boundaries in robotics and industry.
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and optimize high-efficiency power electronic & motor control systems. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed requirements and functional designs for power electronic circuits & motor controllers.. 
   
 

•  

Perform simulations, testing, and validation to ensure system performance meets all requirements. 
   
 

•  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the design, prototyping, and manufacturing phases. 
   
 

•  

Ensure products are compliant with relevant standards for power drive systems. 
   
 

•  

Stay informed about the latest trends and developments in power electronics in robotics & industrial applications. 
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Minimum of 3 years of experience in power electronics & circuit design.
   
 

•  

Strong knowledge of inverters and motor controllers.
   
 

•  

Experience with PCB design tools such as Kicad, Altium or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Experience with electronic circuit simulation software such as LTSpice or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Understanding of thermal management and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
   
 

•  

Previous experience in model-based design and/or FPGA platforms will be considered a plus.
   
 

•  

A team player with excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
   
 

•  

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

You will work on the production line.

• You fill food products.

• You check if the weight is correct.

• You take products off the production line.

• You place products in boxes.

• You put the correct labels on the products.

• You check that everything is correct.

• You keep your work area clean and tidy.

• You follow the rules for hygiene and food safety.

• You work together with your colleagues to make sure the work is finished on time.

We are looking for someone who:

• speaks Dutch. Good French or English is also possible

• likes to work and stay active : likes working with their hands

• can work accurately

• follows hygiene rules

• has no problem working in a cold environment of 0°C to 4°C

• has no problem with physical work

• is flexible when the work takes a little longer. It can happen that the work is not finished at the planned end time. In that case, you continue working until everything is finished;
is willing to work full-time.

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but not required. No experience? No problem, you will learn the job on site.

Experience with an electric pallet truck or forklift is a plus. A valid certificate is an extra advantage.

Monday to Thursday: 07:30 – 16:00

Friday: 07:30 – 13:30
