Our client is a logistics service provider based in Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Technical Superintendent or maritime engineer with a passion for inland shipping, vessel management, and technical operations? Do you speak German fluently and enjoy working closely with crews and shipyards?

This is your opportunity to take a key role in managing a modern inland fleet in the Antwerp region.

Your Role as Technical Superintendent

As a Technical Superintendent Inland Shipping, you are responsible for the technical performance, maintenance, and reliability of the fleet. You act as the crucial link between crew, suppliers, and management.

Key responsibilities:
	
• Monitor the technical condition and operational performance of vessels	
• Plan and coordinate maintenance, repairs, and inspections	
• Visit vessels regularly (2–3 times per week)	
• Provide technical support to crews and build strong working relationships	
• Handle technical incidents and breakdowns (on-call rotation)	
• Manage and execute technical projects, refits, and upgrades	
• Develop and follow up on preventive maintenance plans (PMS)	
• Maintain contact with shipyards, suppliers, and classification societies	
• Manage the technical budget and advise on long-term investments

Your Profile:
	
• Bachelor’s degree in Maritime Technology, Electromechanics, or Engineering	
• Proven experience as a Technical Superintendent / Vessel Manager (preferably inland shipping)	
• Fluent in German and English (mandatory requirement)	
• Knowledge of ship engines, propulsion systems, and electrical installations	
• Experience with PMS systems and technical documentation	
• Familiar with classification rules and maritime regulations	
• Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mentality	
• Excellent communicator, able to connect with technical teams and crew	
• Flexible and willing to travel frequently

PROJECT

You work within the department of Communication Information Systems and Sensors (CISS) of the Faculty Polytechnics of the RMA. You conduct technical research support activities on multiple research projects entitled `Advanced SATCOM L1/L2 Threat and Resilience Assessment (ASTRA)', Wearable Adaptive Antenna-Radio Systems for Reliable Tactical Communications (WARCOM)' and `Adaptive Laser Countermeasures Against Advanced IR-guided Threats' (ALCAAT).

 

ASTRA aims at identifying vulnerabilities in modern satellite communication systems at physical and data link layer level and assessing their resilience through the design and implementation of passive and active RF attacks in a controlled laboratory environment. 

 

WARCOM focuses on the design, fabrication, integration and evaluation of adaptive wearable antenna systems for tactical communications, ensuring compatibility with current and future tactical radios. The project includes electromagnetic simulations, laboratory RF measurements and field testing under realistic operational conditions. 

 

ALCAAT aims to develop adaptive laser-based countermeasures that react quickly to modern infrared (IR) threats. It will evaluate how atmospheric conditions affect their effectiveness against imaging seekers through laboratory and field trials. The goal is to advance the Technology Readiness Level (TRL) from 3 to 5 by transitioning from controlled environments to outdoor testing.

 

Within these projects, you support researchers and PhD candidates by preparing and maintaining experimental setups, managing laboratory infrastructure, and assisting in measurement campaigns and integration activities. 

 

MAIN TASKS

• Preparation, installation and maintenance of RF, Telecommunications, and (opto-)electronics laboratory setups including Software Defined Radio platforms, SATCOM terminals, antennas, spectrum analyzers and related equipment. 
• Support in the execution of laboratory measurements and field trials. 
• Technical integration of radio systems, embedded platforms and measurement equipment.
• Management of equipment inventory, calibration follow-up and safety procedures. 
• Preparation and follow up of purchases of technical and test equipment in accordance with procurement procedures.
• Occasional support during demonstrations and interactions with Defense stakeholders and industrial partners. 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Apicbase is a fast-growing SaaS scale-up transforming how hospitality and food & beverage businesses run their operations. International restaurant groups, hotel chains, and foodservice operators trust our platform.
 

We're looking for a true HR generalist to own our People processes end-to-end, someone dynamic and ambitious who can grow over time.
 

You'll be hands-on across the full HR spectrum: recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, following up on evaluation and appraisal conversations, processing HR data, and keeping our HR cycles, including payroll, running on time. You're genuinely curious about data, and you never take a process for granted.
 

We're a scale-up, which means the way we did things six months ago probably isn't the way we should do them today, and you're the one who keeps asking, "can this be better?"
 

A lot will be ad hoc, and this role will evolve as we go. You're someone who's energised by that, not thrown off by it
 

 
 

What will you do (in a nutshell)?
 
 

•  

Recruitment
 

You own hiring from vacancy to signed contract: sourcing and screening candidates, coordinating and sitting in on interviews, and making sure every hire has a smooth, professional experience, helping us attract the ambitious, dynamic people a scale-up needs.
 

 
  

•  

Onboarding & offboarding
 

From day one to last day, you coordinate the full lifecycle: warm onboarding and a flying start for new joiners, and correct, compliant offboarding when people leave.
 

 
  

•  

Evaluation & appraisal follow-up
 

You set up and follow up on evaluation and appraisal conversations, scheduling them, tracking outcomes and actions, and making sure managers and employees actually complete the cycle on time.
 

 
  

•  

HR data & reporting
 

You process and bring together HR data from different sources, build clear dashboards, and flag what matters, whether that's an absenteeism trend, a retention signal, or headcount planning.
 

 
  

•  

HR cycles & payroll follow-up

You keep our recurring HR cycles on track, including following up on payroll with our provider, so deadlines are never missed and data going into payroll is always correct and on time.
  

You have 3–5 years in a broad, operational HR or People role. Beyond that, here's what makes you a great fit:
 
 

•  

A true generalist: you're comfortable moving between recruitment, onboarding, data
, and payroll follow-up in the same week.
  

•  

Ambitious & growth-minded: you see this role as a step, not a ceiling; you want to grow into more responsibility as the company grows.
  

•  

Data-driven: data and systems give you energy, not anxiety. You love finding structure in a fast-paced environment.
  

•

jobs.occupation: Researcher in Weapon Systems and Ballistics (RAPTOR) M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT

You work within the Department of Weapon Systems and Ballistics (ABAL) of the Royal Military Academy, and in close collaboration with the industrial and academic partners of the consortium. You conduct scientific research at university level on a project entitled 'RAPTOR'.

RAPTOR addresses the growing defence need created by the proliferation of drones that threaten civil and military security. The project aims to facilitate and accelerate the development of innovative weapon systems, specifically designed to neutralise these mobile air targets efficiently by integrating artificial intelligence in fire control algorithms and target designation. Four objectives structure the work: reducing the time-to-market, reducing the cost, remaining at the state of the art, and guaranteeing the performance of the weapon systems studied.

The incumbent will contribute to weapon system performance studies and test campaigns, provide fragmentation modelling that feeds the multi-source data fusion activities, characterise representative C-UAS operational scenarios drawn from the open literature, analyse the vulnerability and the survivability of drone targets, define the fragment patterns that maximise terminal effects, quantify aerodynamic coefficients, study collateral damage risk and contribute to the preparation, execution and exploitation of the experimental firing campaigns.

 

MAIN TASKS

• Model representative C-UAS operational scenarios on the basis of concrete cases available in the open literature, with a focus on the neutralisation phase.
• Analyse the vulnerability and the survivability of drone targets component by component, including the determination of critical thresholds and of the number of impacts required to reach a defined level of neutralisation.
• Perform fragmentation simulations with dedicated software and calibrate the analytical models on experimental results, in order to define the fragment patterns that maximise terminal effects.
• Contribute to the quantification of the aerodynamic coefficients used by the Point Mass model for fragmentation and by the 6DOF model for the ballistic trajectory.
• Quantify collateral damage and the associated risk probability, so that the choice of the engagement approach can be balanced against ballistic performance.
• Contribute to the elaboration of the test application document, participate in the firing campaigns and in the data acquisition, and support the post-processing and the writing of the test reports.
• Validate the simulations by reproducing the representative scenarios on the test range and by comparing simulated and experimental survivability.
• Contribute to technical reports, to the deliverables towards the funding authority, and to scientific publications and conferences. 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree(s) required: Master's degree in Engineering (Applied Sciences, Engineering Sciences), preferably in mechanical, aerospace, electromechanical or a closely related discipline.

This position is open for junior profiles (ideally 0-3 years of experience) and experienced profiles (ideally 3 years of experience minimum).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills

• Academic experience (projects, master's thesis) or professional experience in the numerical modelling and simulation of mechanical, aerodynamic or ballistic problems.
• Academic or professional experience in experimental test campaigns and data acquisition.
• Programming skills.
• 
Proficiency in the production of technical and/or scientific documents.

 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills 

• Training or experience in ballistics, weapon systems or fragmentation modelling.
• Training or experience with drones, C-UAS systems or weapon systems performance.
• Training or experience with Split-X and/or Python.
• Training or experience in artificial intelligence.
Personal skills

• You conduct scientific research in an independent and upright way within a multidisciplinary environment.
• You communicate your results in a clear, concise and precise manner.
• You are involved, innovative and result oriented.
• You solve problems autonomously, take initiative and find alternatives or solutions.
• You will be working very closely together with the partners and will get insight in their proprietary intellectual property. Confidentiality is therefore an absolute must.
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral / written).
• The applicant shall have good knowledge of French (oral / written).
• Minimum knowledge of Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers.
• Experience in scientific literature review and scientific writing is an added value.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defense.
• Only applicants with a nationality of a country that is both part of NATO and the EU will be eligible.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study.
 
 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: From 01/11/2026, in consultation with the applicant. 
• Status: Full-time employment based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• Wage scale: Salary scale: wage scale NA11 (holder of a Master's degree in Science or equivalent), or NA21 (holder of an Ir degree or equivalent Master's in Engineering Sciences, doctor's degree in the same area of expertise), with valuable / relevant seniority.  A salary simulation can be done here: Simulateur de salaire. RMA applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations.
• 
Holiday pay.

 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day);
• Digital allowance: 15€ / month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years) 
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we don't just design solutions—we engineer the future with bold ideas and a hands-on approach. Our mission is to rethink what's possible in engineering and R&D. Though our team is small, our ambitions are anything but. We move fast, think big, and are driven by curiosity and a shared passion for innovation.
 

About the role
 

Join our R&D team as a Mechanical Design Engineer , where you'll contribute to the development of cutting-edge axial flux motors.

•  

Design innovative solutions for new product challenges.

•

•

Traxx is looking for a Mechanical and Thermal Simulations Engineer to join our rapidly growing team. You will be responsible for the structural and mechanical simulation of our axial flux motors and their components, while supporting the development and validation of thermal models for our motors and inverters. 
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Strengthen the Simulation Team by improving our structural and mechanical simulation capabilities. 
   
 

•  

Perform structural FEA simulations to evaluate strength, stiffness, fatigue, vibration, and thermal-mechanical behavior of motor components.
   
 

•  

Support the development and validation of thermal simulation models for axial flux motors and power electronics.
   
 

•  

Develop analytical models to complement simulation results and support design decisions.
   
 

•

help local retail thrive internationally.
 

A sports shop in Namur, a bookshop in Ghent or a pet store in Rotterdam may have

Retailers keep their store, identity and existing operations without having to become e-commerce experts.
 

The model is proven: steady monthly growth, no customer churn since launch and partnerships underway with major distributors. After a strong start in French-speaking Belgium, Ekwip is now expanding into Flanders and the Netherlands.

About Fluves
 

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber-optic sensing, combining advanced DTS and DAS technology, real-time data processing and smart analytics to monitor and protect critical infrastructure.
 

Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves monitors more than 1,800 km of subsea power cables connecting offshore wind farms and power grids. The DALI product line detects leaks and intrusions in water networks, while Fluves Corrosion assesses the risk of corrosion under insulation in chemical plants.
 

Based in Ghent, Fluves is a growing technology scale-up active in critical infrastructure markets around the world.
 

 
 

Your role
 

As Field & Operations Technician, you will be part of the Fluves delivery team. You will support the practical and technical execution of customer projects, both on-site and from our Ghent office.
 

You will prepare, execute, verify and document the installation of fiber-optic cables and electronic equipment at locations in Belgium and neighbouring countries. You will work closely with project managers, technical experts, subcontractors and customers to ensure that delivery work is carried out safely, reliably and in accordance with Fluves’ quality standards.
 

This is a hands-on role for someone who is independent, responsible, customer-oriented and well organized.
 

 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Prepare and support fiber installations based on customer information, technical drawings and internal requirements. 

 

• Brief subcontractors before work starts, provide practical guidance during installation, and inspect and document the quality of the completed work. 

 

• Splice fiber-optic cables and repair damaged cables. 

 

• Record installed fiber routes and maintain accurate project documentation. 

 

• Prepare, test and configure equipment before shipment or installation. 

 

• Mount devices and prepare hardware for customer projects. 

 

• Prepare shipments and ensure that project materials are complete, correctly packed and properly documented. 

 

• Maintain and organize the Fluves warehouse, including equipment, tools, test setups and project materials. 

 

• Support project managers with practical technical tasks before, during and after project execution. 

 

• Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, subcontractors and colleagues. 

 

• Help ensure that installations, equipment and project documentation meet Fluves’ quality standards. 

 

• Follow all applicable safety procedures, identify and report hazards, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our working methods. 

 

• Act as Fluves’ operational lead on site and help ensure that Fluves personnel and subcontractors work in accordance with our safety and quality standards. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a solid practical technical background, ideally through a technical bachelor’s degree, graduate degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

 

• You are hands-on and comfortable working with technical equipment, power tools, cabling, racks, sensors and electrical components. 

 

• You work carefully and have a strong eye for detail, particularly when documenting installations, inspecting work or preparing equipment for customer projects. 

 

• You have a strong safety mindset and are willing to obtain the necessary safety certificates and training. 

 

• You are responsible, reliable and well organized. When you take on a task, others can trust that you will follow it through properly.

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to architect and design the future of technology-aware compute systems.
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 
 

We are looking for a Virtual Platform R&D Engineer to develop, enable, and maintain our baseline platform across functional models, RTL prototyping, and simulation environments. This role sits at the intersection of compute architecture, system software, and system modeling. 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Develop and maintain virtual platforms across both simulated, and hardware-prototyping environments. 

• Support workload mapping and enable functional models bring-up on various execution platforms such as: QEMU, gem5, RTL, FGPA. 

• Contribute to performance and functional validation across abstraction levels (ISA → RTL → FPGA). 

• Build system models that represent novel compute architectures, while balancing accuracy, execution speed, and ease of use. 

• Evaluate new architectural features, translating architectural concepts into executable platforms. 

• Contribute to project definitions and the technical scope of work (timeline, work packages, milestones, deliverables) in cooperation with senior members, if needed.  

• Supervise or assist in mentoring students when necessary.  

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or other relevant domains with hands-on compute architecture systems.   

• You are passionate about computer architecture and system-level design, with a solid understanding of modern compute and memory systems, and SoC components.  

• You have a strong background in embedded systems, including toolchains (GCC/LLVM), RTOS (e.g., Zephyr), and low-level debugging.  

• You are proficient in C/C++, in bash and Python scripting.  

• You are a hands-on engineer who enjoys bringing systems to life.  

• You have experience in RISC-V-based system architecture.   

• You are open-minded, and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs.   

• You are a team player, as you will be part of a dynamic and distributed team.  

• You are fluent in English and you have strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across a multicultural team.

jobs.occupation: Junior Researcher on Interoperability and Architecture Design for Autonomous Ground Systems (iMUGS2) M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT 

You work within the Robotics & Autonomous Systems (https://mecatron.rma.ac.be/) research unit of the department of Mechanics of the Polytechnic Faculty of the RMA. You conduct scientific research at university level on a project entitled ¿iMUGS2¿. Your research will focus on the application of Multi-Agent Collaboration technology for collaborative autonomy in unmanned ground systems, including: 

• Develop an interoperable, open, and modular multi-agent architecture in the global architecture of the project's System-of-Systems 
• Study and integration of optimal multi-robot planning algorithms 
• Define communication interface to enable the exchange of information between the team 
 

Given the applied nature of this project and its strong involvement in European-scale collaborative defence programs, you will occasionally prepare and participate in on-site demonstrations and field trials, mainly on military sites in Europe. 

 

MAIN TASKS 

 

• Lead development and implementation of standards that enable interoperability, focusing on mission management and multi-agent autonomy. 
• Leading the planning and execution of international demonstration campaigns. 
• Support in testing and validation of the multi-agent framework. 
• Contribute to integration with ROS/ROS2 of the developed solutions in real vehicles. 
• Document your research and contribute to scientific publications, deliverables, and project reports.  
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

Degree(s) required / ideal degree(s): Master/Engineer's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or related fields 

This position is open for junior profiles (ideally 0-3 years of experience) or experienced profiles (up to 10 years of experience. 

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills: 

• Excellent oral & written knowledge of English 
• Experience in Robotics and knowledge in ROS/ROS2 
• Good programming skills in Python and/or C++ 
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:  

• Experience in Multi-Agent Collaboration, or multimodal AI 
• Knowledge in simulation environments for robotics 
• Knowledge in robotics and/or software architecture design 
• Knowledge in interoperability, standardisation and/or, more specifically, NATO STANAG/STANREC standards 
• Experience in organising tests and demonstrations 
• Minimum knowledge of French or Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers. 
Personal skills: 

• Ability to work independently and in a multi-disciplinary, international team 
• You will be working closely together with multiple industrial and academic partners and will get insight in their proprietary intellectual property. Confidentiality is therefore an absolute must. 
• You are comfortable working in a complex international, multi-partner environment, fostering constructive collaboration, and resolving interpersonal tensions when needed. 
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS 

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence. 
• The researcher will be working within the context of European or NATO projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens. 
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study.  
CONTRACT 

• Probable date of recruitment: From 15 October 2026, in consultation with the applicant.  
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours/week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant). 
• Please note that your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to the funding project, which is guaranteed until November 2028 (end of iMUGS2 project). There is a high chance for the project to be prolonged after this initial period, depending on the availability of new funding.  
• Wage scale: class NA11 (holder of a Master's degree in Science or equivalent), or NA21 (holder of an Ir degree or equivalent Master's in Engineering Sciences, doctor's degree in the same area of expertise), with valuable / relevant seniority.  A salary simulation can be done here: Simulateur de salaire. RMA applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations. 
• Holiday pay. 
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS 

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test; 
• End-of-year bonus; 
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member); 
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute); 
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day); 
• Digital allowance: 15€ / month; 
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours; 
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu); 
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week; 
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max); 
• Holidays:  
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years)  
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays). 
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...); 
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;

jobs.occupation: Manager Consolidation and Reporting - Walloon Brabant
jobs.description:
A European industrial group operating in multiple countries is reinforcing its Group Finance structure and is hiring a Manager / Head of Consolidation & Group Reporting.

The group works with complex operations, numerous entities and a strong international footprint, requiring robust reporting frameworks and high-quality consolidated financials.

Their offices are located in Walloon Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

You will lead the consolidation and reporting function, oversee IFRS compliance and safeguard the accuracy, consistency and timeliness of group accounts. As a key advisor to senior finance leadership, you will drive harmonisation of accounting practices and continuous improvement of the consolidation environment.

• Excellent communication with the ability to influence stakeholders across countries
• Fluent in English (French is a plus).

jobs.occupation: International Inside Sales - High-Performance Metal Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.

jobs.occupation: Brand and Category Manager - FMCG - Confectionary company
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international FMCG company with a strong portfolio of well-established brands enjoyed by millions of consumers worldwide. Combining a rich heritage with a forward-thinking mindset, the company develops and markets high-quality products that are part of consumers' everyday lives.

With a significant international footprint, multiple production sites across several countries, and thousands of employees worldwide, the organization combines global scale with a strong local-market focus. Its success is driven by a deep understanding of consumer needs, continuous innovation, and a commitment to delivering products that consumers know, trust, and love.

The company offers a dynamic, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment where employees are empowered to make an impact and contribute to the growth of iconic brands.

The Brand & Category Manager is responsible for developing, managing, and driving the performance of the company's brands and product categories (sweet biscuits, chocolate, savoury).

This role leads the marketing strategy for the Belgium market, optimizes the product assortment, analyzes business performance, and ensures alignment between consumer needs, market trends, and business objectives, all while supporting the broader strategic vision of the group.Keys responsibilities and activities

Brand Management:

• Define and implement the annual marketing plan in terms of product portfolio, innovation, communication, consumer/shopper activation.
• Contribute to the preparation of the yearly marketing budget. Be responsible to follow up the spendings, making sure you stay aligned with the agreed yearly budget.
• Collaborate with the Netherlands, France, England and Turkey team on cross-border concepts, innovation launches. Recommend the relevant innovations and go-to market plan for Belgium market and prepare the launch plans.

• Be in permanent contact with external agencies and internal stakeholders (production, logistics, finance, legal, marketing, new product development).
• Monitor and analyse brands and products performances.

• Analyse Categories to identify the growth drivers. Participate in key customer meetings to share the Category Perspective and insights.
• Analyse customer performances and shopper data to develop sharp sales argumentation for business review and customer presentations (Colruyt, Delhaize, Carrefour, Intermarché, HD).
• Guide and work closely with Sales teams to optimize brand plan execution.

• A bachelor's or master's degree, preferably in a commercial & marketing field.
• 4-6 years working experience in a similar role in FMCG sector.
• Strong analytical and project management skills and a feel for retail, sales, or marketing.
• You combine an analytical mind with creativity and present ideas clearly and convincingly.
• You speak French, Dutch & English.

• You are proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
• Knowledge of Nielsen is required.

jobs.occupation: Electromechanical Technician - motors & machinery | Brucargo | ENG
jobs.description:
For a technical maintenance company operating at the airport, we are looking for a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery. As a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on a wide range of Ground Support Equipment (GSE), including pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, and other motorized vehicles. You will ensure that all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with current standards.

Your responsibilities include:

 

 
•  
 Performing maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on GSE equipment (pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, etc.). 

 
• Troubleshooting and resolving faults in electrical and electronic assemblies. 
 
• Installing, testing, and commissioning electrical systems according to current safety standards and regulations. 
 

 
• Documenting maintenance and repair activities and contributing to technical reports. 
 
•  
Providing on-the-job training to other mechanics on troubleshooting and complex electrical systems. 

 
• Ensuring compliance with legal regulations, safety standards, and quality assurance guidelines. 
 
•  
Keeping tools, equipment, and test devices in good working condition through routine checks and cleaning. 

 
• Preparing equipment for handover to customers or deployment on airport sites. 
 

 
• Coordinating with mechanical, electrical, and workshop technicians to ensure efficient and safe execution of repair and maintenance tasks. 

 
• Completed vocational training as an industrial electrician, electronics technician for industrial engineering, mechatronics technician, or a comparable qualification. 
 
• Extensive experience in the maintenance and repair of electrical systems, ideally in aviation or a related technical field. 
 
• Experience with high voltage equipment, preferably with certification. 
 
• Extensive knowledge of control technology and proficiency in reading circuit diagrams. 
 
• Excellent communication skills to report issues and collaborate with other workshop personnel. 
 
• Good command of local language as well as English language, both spoken and written. 
 
• Class B driving license, additional driving permits are an advantage. 
 
• Possess or are eligible to obtain an airport security pass and an airport driving permit.

jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL 

Do you want to play a key role in the digital transformation of Belgium’s largest bank? Are you a driven people manager with a strong technical background, eager to lead a team of developers to the next level? If so, you could be our new Chapter Lead Developers within the Tribe Customer Servicing & Efficiency! 

Within our tribe, we focus on innovative customer interactions through our Contact Center platform and advanced automation (including robotics and ServiceNow). Our goal is to deliver efficient, user-friendly solutions that simplify life for both customers and employees. Additionally, we play a crucial role in fraud prevention and detection, protecting our bank and customers from threats. 

Our multidisciplinary teams (squads) combine IT and business expertise to develop technological solutions that enhance customer service and process efficiency. As part of Agile Impulse, you’ll work in a dynamic, agile environment where innovation and collaboration are key. 

 

AND IN DETAIL 

As Chapter Lead of Automation Engineers, you’ll lead a skilled development team while serving as both a people manager and a technical expert. You’ll report directly to the IT Tribe Lead and be part of the tribe leadership team. 

 

As a People Manager, you will: 

• You nurture the colleagues in your chapter by ensuring they develop the right skills & knowledge and you manage with them their career plans; 
• You build, together with your peer chapter leads, on a continuous changing and challenging sourcing strategy. 
• You recruit new chapter members in line with current & future needs of the tribe and ensure a good onboarding of them; you are also in charge of the knowledge management; 
• You ensure an open and transparent communication with resource suppliers thinking along in the multiple established value based partnerships. 
• You support chapter members on difficult or complex questions and support them in the necessary changes by developing their agile maturity 
• You provide during the year continuous feedback to your chapter members and are responsible for the annual evaluation and the renumeration decisions in your chapter. 
• You contribute to the daily functioning of the tribe and represent your chapter in the tribe leadership team 
• You help building an open feedback culture at all levels in our tribe and cultivate an open communication and a high level of trust. You act as a sponsor in one or multiple communities of practice (CoP) within the tribe. 
 

As an Expert, you will: 

• Initiate and lead improvements within the tribe based on your technical expertise. 
• Collaborate closely with squads, product owners, agile coaches, and stakeholders to continuously enhance ways of working, tools, and skills. 
• Translate technical needs into strategic development points for your chapter and the Developers Community of BNP Paribas Fortis. 
• Being part of the tribe leadership team, you dare to step outside of your role to intervene when needed on other transversal roles or topics like incident management, vulnerabilities management, DevOps Embedding,… 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES 

• At least 2 years of experience in a similar role. 
• Experience in coaching and mentoring teams. 
• Strong knowledge of software engineering and development/testing methodologies; a technical background in Robotic Process Automation (Blue Prism, UiPath, etc. is a plus. 
• Excellent interpersonal skills-you understand your team’s needs and foster a growth mindset. 
• Agile expertise-you’re familiar with agile teams and methodologies. 
• Passion for innovation and a proactive attitude. 
• Fluent in Dutch or French (oral and written) with strong English skills.

Your role is structured around four main areas, each contributing to the stability and continuous improvement of the IT infrastructure.

License Management (20%)

You will be responsible for managing software licenses, including Microsoft subscriptions and on-premises licensing, Oracle, VMware, Apple, and other software vendors, monitoring software acquisitions, renewals, and retirements, ensuring license compliance and validating software usage and requests.

Contract Management (20%)

• Managing support and maintenance contract renewals.

• Contributing to the preparation of technical specifications for new procurement processes.
• Ensuring suppliers comply with technical requirements and agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Data Center & Infrastructure (10%)

• Oversee the day-to-day management of data center facilities operated by external partners.
• Coordinate maintenance and operational activities.
• Assess physical infrastructure requirements, including power, cooling, and rack capacity.
• Manage the installation, relocation, and decommissioning of IT equipment.
Capacity & Asset Management (50%)

• Coordinate the retirement, redeployment, or resale of IT equipment.
• Maintain an accurate IT asset inventory and ensure the Configuration Management Database remains up to date.
• Optimize asset utilization and manage hardware stock levels.
• Prepare and monitor CAPEX and OPEX budgets related to IT infrastructure.
• Forecast infrastructure capacity requirements over a 1- to 4-year horizon in close collaboration with the Architecture team.
• Ensure compliance with IT equipment standards and the corporate IT service catalogue.

Profile

• Proven experience in IT infrastructure, capacity planning, IT asset management, software license management, and vendor contract management.
• Solid understanding of data center environments, ITIL processes, IT asset inventories, and CMDB management.

• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
• Excellent analytical abilities with a proactive approach to optimization and long-term planning.
• Able to work independently while taking ownership and responsibility.
• Clear communicator who enjoys collaborating in a professional and approachable manner.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Build the backbone of our digital future as a Web Infrastructure Architect in our Agile Production Services (APS) tribe. Based in Brussels (HQ), you’ll design, secure, and optimize the high-performance web infrastructure that powers our business, working alongside a diverse, skilled team to push boundaries in scalability, security, and cloud innovation.

If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and shaping enterprise-grade web solutions, this is where your expertise will make an impact.

 

AND IN DETAIL

You won’t just maintain systems, you’ll engineer resilience, performance, and security into every layer of our web infrastructure. 
Here’s how:

Design with precision

• Craft Detailed Technical Designs (DTDs) that turn business needs into scalable, future-proof architectures.
• Define reference architectures to standardize how we build, deploy, and secure web applications.
Solve deep technical problems

• Debug complex incidents using APM tools, logs, and traces, finding root causes and fixing them for good.
• Optimize performance by analyzing application flows, bottlenecks, and resource usage (think: WebSphere tuning, Kubernetes scaling, TLS handshakes).
Secure and modernize

• Harden our web hosting (WebSphere, Tomcat, IIS) and security layers (F5 WAF, ISVA, API Gateway, oAuth2, HSM).
• Lead cloud migration and optimization (IaaS/PaaS) while keeping costs and risks in check.
• Collaborate and influence
• Work closely with DevOps, Security, and Development teams to ensure designs are practical, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
• Mentor and guide, your expertise will help raise the bar for the entire team.
• Keep us ahead of the curve
• Monitor, measure, and improve, proactively spotting risks and opportunities in our web infrastructure.
• Drive cost-efficiency initiatives, from right-sizing resources to decommissioning legacy systems.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who lives and breathes web infrastructure with the skills to back it up.

 

Core Technical Skills (Must-Have)

• 5+ years in infrastructure architecture, with hands-on experience in:
• Web Application Hosting: WebSphere, Kubernetes, IIS, Tomcat
• Web Security: F5 WAF, ISVA, API Gateway, HSM, oAuth2, TLS
• Cloud Environments: IaaS/PaaS (design, migration, optimization)
• Performance troubleshooting: APM tools, logging, tracing, capacity planning
• Incident analysis: Root-cause investigation for web infrastructure issues
 

How You Work

• Analytical and data-driven: You don’t guess, you measure, analyze, and optimize.
• Collaborative: You thrive in cross-functional teams (Security, DevOps, Development) and can explain complex tech simply.
• Proactive and pragmatic: You spot problems before they happen and solve them efficiently.
 

Nice-to-Haves

Soft Skills

 • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

• CE driving licence with certificates
 • Flexible mindset
 • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian

Position overview:
 

 
 

You manage the plant’s environmental, health and safety (EHS), fire safety and property protection (FSPP) sustainability programmes to ensure the safety and well-being of all workers and protection of the environment. You also provide advice and guidance to plant management on EHS, FSPP, sustainability issues, and proactively management of EHS and FSPP risks to ensure the plant meets it compliance obligations and Ball requirements and implements best practice. Coordinate EHS activity, including EHS management systems (ISO and ASI) (certified where applicable). Accountable for rolling out Ball EHS BOE (Ball Operational Excellence) and sustainability initiatives.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

 
 
 

• Develop and implement BBS and proactive reporting and engagement initiatives such as near miss, hazard and/or good catch to promote safe behaviours and develop a positive safety culture. 

• Identify and ensure compliance with EHS compliance obligations (e.g. laws, regulations, permits, licences etc) and other stakeholder requirements (e.g. FSPP insurance). 

• Ensure plant management and workers are aware of, take ownership and deliver on their respective EHS accountabilities and responsibilities, including deputies to cover absences. Escalate issues promptly to the plant manager and Regional EHS. 

• Implement and maintain hazard identification and risk assessment programme that reflects hazards during normal, abnormal and emergency conditions and apply the hierarchy of control. Incorporates the Ball BOE, LiFE and hazard mapping into risk management programmes. 

• Identify and assess environment aspects and manage significant impacts under normal, abnormal and emergency conditions including emissions to air, waste, water, wastewater, energy and VOCs. Implement programs to manage significant impacts such as waste minimisation management strategy, pollution prevention, ecological issues. Manage environmental protection infrastructure. 

• Manage the timely reporting, recording, investigation and identification of root causes of EHS incidents and complaints along with oversight of corrective actions including Global reporting via Enablon and Alerts. 

• Work with functional department leaders to develop and implement EHS programmes, requirements, rules, procedures, systems to manage EHS risk and meet all EHS requirements and drive continuous improvement. 

• Establish and implement robust communication and consultation channels to raise awareness, drive engagement, provide information on EHS issues including oversight of the EHS committee and liaison with Safety Representatives. 

• Implement and maintain integrated EHS management systems (and where applicable maintain certification to ISO 14001, ISO 45001, BRC, food safety standards and integrated with ISO 9001) including oversight of external and internal audits, FSPP surveys and management reviews. Follows up on corrective actions. 

• Implement occupational / industrial hygiene, occupational health and well-being programmes in accordance with identified risks and legal requirements in consultation with HR and external providers. 

• Act as primary liaison with regulatory authorities and other external stakeholders (for example insurers, auditors) and internal stakeholders (Regional and Global EHS, Group Insurance, Group Security) and ensure their requirements and reporting are dealt with efficiently. 

What are we looking for?
 

 
 
 

• Min. 5 years of EHS experience, with 3 years management in a similar industry, with proactive shopfloor engagement and comprehensive knowledge of EHS risks and issues. 

• Relevant EHS qualification to a high level (minimum diploma or local equivalent); alternatively engineering qualification with relevant experience of at least 3 years in an EHS managerial role in manufacturing, heavy engineering or construction. 

• Comprehensive knowledge of EHS legislative requirements. 

• Working knowledge of implementing behaviour-based safety programmes. 

• Managing fire safety and property protection insurance risks. 

• Excellent computer skills (Proficient in MS Office Suite). 

• Fluent in written and spoken English and Dutch.

• Automated investigation steps o Response actions and containment strategies o Escalation and handover points to analysts

Automation Lifecycle Management

• Tune playbooks to reduce noise, false positives, and manual

MLOps (30-40%)

• Collaborate closely with ML engineers, developers, DevOps and infrastructure teams for smooth delivery

You stay in the code, you stay curious about what happens after deployment, and you keep learning as you go.

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to architect and design the future of technology-aware networks in compute systems.µ
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced Network Architect/Researcher to join our team. In this position, you will play a key role in pathfinding future network designs enabled by emerging architectural and technological innovations (e.g., photonic/optical interconnect, wireless, etc.). 

This R&D role focuses on network architecture and design at all levels of a compute system, spanning networks-on-chip, IO chiplets/dies, scale-up and scale-out network at machine-scale, depending on the impact of emerging technologies in various application domains. You will be expected to collaborate with experts from application, technology, circuit, and design domains to evaluate the impact of technological innovations in network architecture of the future.
 

Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in applications, technology, circuits and design (across imec) to define novel technology-aware network architectures.  

• Lead feasibility studies through performance modeling and prototyping to provide expert guidance on design and implementation of next-gen network architectures.  

• Engage in R&D activities within project teams to take research ideas towards higher maturity levels, solving hands-on technical and engineering challenges in the process.  

• Stay up to date with the advancements in network architectures in compute systems, specifically in terms of novel technologies, design, and application domains.  

• Contribute to project definitions and the technical scope of work (timeline, work packages, milestones, deliverables) in close cooperation with the stakeholders.  

• Supervise or assist in mentoring Masters/Doctoral students/interns when necessary, and contribute to improved ways of working and shared knowledge across CSA.  

• Publish relevant results and artefacts in high-impact journals, conferences, seminars and open-source ecosystems to highlight CSA contributions to the community.  

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or relevant domains with strong R&D experience in network architecture/design.  

• You have 6+ years of relevant experience in industry and/or academia (we encourage you to apply if you have slightly less experience but strong alignment with the role).  

• You have proven expertise in network architecure/design, including topology, routing, congestion control, communication protocols, resilience, and performance analysis.  

• You have a good understanding of optical or electrical circuit switching, and you are familiar with recent industry initiatives around Ultra-ethernet, CXL, UALink, etc.  

• You have hands-on experience with network profiling and detailed network modeling tools such as NS3, OMNET++, SST Merlin, gem5 Garnet, AstraSim, etc.  

• You have experience developing system-level architectural models for networks, quantitative analysis frameworks, or system-level evaluation methodologies.  

• You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, with an experience in designing and executing experiments to derive insights from complex system behavior.  

• You are able to collaborate across abstraction layers, translating technology, circuit, and design information into meaningful architectural and system-level insights.  

• You have the knowledge and experience with good software and research engineering practices (e.g., version control, reproducibility, automation, testing, documentation).  

• You enjoy being hands-on while working with your colleagues and while mentoring students/interns, promoting a team culture of creativity, collaboration, and excellence.  

• You are a team player and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs; you are self-motivated, responsible and willing to take ownership.  

• You feel at home and know how to integrate into a multicultural environment; you are open-minded, you seek and embrace differences and accept constructive challenges.  

• You have effective English communication skills for discussions, documentations, and dissemination of ideas and results within CSA/IMEC and in wider ecosystems.

jobs.description:
Permanent | From €6,000 gross/month | Leuven

Thirty countries. Sixty legal entities. A BPO partner in India. Monthly closes under pressure and an ERP migration running straight through live operations. You've been there, and you know exactly how to bring structure, calm and quality to an environment that never stops moving.

 

We're looking for an AP Manager to lead the European AP hub of an international market leader in medical products, based in Leuven. This is a Global Business Services environment with teams spanning Belgium, the UK and India, an active finance transformation programme and products that make a genuine difference in healthcare every single day.

 

 

 

 

 

The Role

As AP Manager, you hold full ownership of the Accounts Payable function and serve as the key link between finance and international business stakeholders. From the European hub in Leuven, you oversee AP operations across Belgium, the United Kingdom and India, working closely with teams distributed around the world.

 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Full AP cycle for European countries: receipt, review, processing and approval of invoices in line with group policy
• Three-way matching, discrepancy follow-up and escalation where required
• Preparation and execution of payment runs across multiple methods (EFT, Wire, ACH, DD, SEPA B2B/B2C)
• Vendor reconciliations, AP subledger alignment with the GL and management of intercompany balances
• Monthly and year-end close activities: accruals, prepayments, open POs and AP adjustments
• Compliance oversight: VAT, Intrastat, SOX requirements, internal controls and segregation of duties
• Building and monitoring KPIs and AP reporting: ageing, vendor spend, payment forecasts and accrual summaries
• Supporting audit processes: providing documentation, explaining reconciliations and implementing recommendations
 

People Management & Leadership

• Managing, coaching and developing international AP teams and BPO partners
• Monitoring SLA quality and operational consistency across outsourced processes
• Providing technical guidance on the ERP system to BPO teams, acting as the go-to for complex processing and system queries
• Visible, engaged leadership: present for your people across time zones and national borders

Your Profile

You're a senior finance professional who knows complex AP environments inside out. You keep your team in sight and know how to introduce structure and composure into an organisation that's constantly evolving.

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a financial discipline
• A minimum of 10 years' relevant experience in AP and GL, ideally across multiple countries and legal entities
• Proven leadership experience, both direct and through BPO coordination and process ownership
• Hands-on knowledge of major ERP systems such as Oracle Cloud Financials or SAP S/4HANA

• Performing data analysis to support decision-making and validate process improvements.
• Defining and documenting business rules, process flows, and functional requirements.
• Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
• Supporting testing activities, acceptance criteria reviews, and solution validation

• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, or in a combined business/process transformation role.
• Proven experience in both business analysis and process analysis within complex environments.
• Strong experience writing and managing Product Backlog Items (PBIs) and working within Agile delivery frameworks.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured approach to decision-making.
• Excellent quantitative reasoning skills and the ability to work with data-driven insights.

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to define the future of system-level reliability in compute systems.
Apply 
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced System-Level Reliability Researcher to join our team. In this position, you will play a key role in developing methodologies to evaluate and improve the reliability of advanced compute architectures. You will focus on how hardware faults, degradation effects, and technology-level reliability observations translate into system-level behavior, application correctness, availability, and product lifetime. 

This R&D role focuses on compute system architecture, reliability modeling, and resilience evaluation. You will collaborate with experts from the technology, device, circuit, and design domains to translate lower-level reliability information into architectural fault models, simulation inputs, and system-level reliability metrics. 
 

Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 

• Developing system-level reliability assessment methods for processors, accelerators, memory subsystems, SoCs, and chiplet-based architectures.  

• Creating architectural fault models and abstractions based on reliability information provided by lower layers of the technology stack.  

• Building and using simulation, emulation, and fault-injection frameworks to study fault propagation, error masking, and application-level impact.  

• Quantifying reliability outcomes such as Silent Data Corruption, detected errors, service interruptions, availability loss, and lifetime-related degradation at the system level.  

• Evaluating Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) mechanisms, including error detection, containment, recovery, redundancy, and graceful degradation techniques.  

• Studying workload-dependent reliability behavior under realistic execution conditions and operating profiles.  

• Connecting technology-informed fault characteristics with system architecture models to support reliability-aware design decisions.  

• Collaborating closely with colleagues within and outside CSA to interface with workload models, architectural simulators, circuit-level reliability data, and technology-level observations.  

• Contributing to research publications, partner discussions, etc.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or relevant domains with strong R&D experience in system-level reliability.  

• You have 6+ years of relevant experience in industry and/or academia (we encourage you to apply if you have slightly less experience but strong alignment with the role).  

• You have a strong background in compute system architecture and microarchitecture.  

• You have a good understanding of core concepts in system-level reliability, resilience, and dependability, including:  
 

•  
 

•  Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) architecture    
 

•  
 

• Fault tolerance and resilience techniques    
 

•  
 

• Error detection, containment, recovery, and graceful degradation    
 

•  
 

• Fault propagation and architectural error masking     
 

• You have experience developing architectural models, quantitative analysis frameworks, or system-level evaluation methodologies.  

• You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, including statistical analysis, data interpretation, and uncertainty-aware reasoning.  

• You have hands-on experience designing and executing experiments to derive insights from complex system behavior.  

• You are able to collaborate across disciplines and abstraction layers, translating reliability information from technology, circuit, and design teams into meaningful architectural models and system-level insights.  

• You have the knowledge and experience with good software and research engineering practices (e.g., version control, reproducibility, automation, testing, documentation).  

• You enjoy being hands-on while working with your colleagues and while mentoring students/interns, promoting a team culture of creativity, collaboration, and excellence.  

• You are a team player and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs; you are self-motivated, responsible and willing to take ownership.  

• You feel at home and know how to integrate into a multicultural environment; you are open-minded, you seek and embrace differences and accept constructive challenges.  

• You have effective English communication skills for discussions, documentations, and dissemination of ideas and results within CSA/IMEC and in wider ecosystems.

jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Architecture Department at BNP Paribas Fortis is the strategic backbone of our digital transformation.

We design the future of banking by shaping secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions that align business vision with cutting-edge IT. Our team of expert architects bridges the gap between security, agility, and customer-centric innovation, ensuring every system-from cloud to core banking-is built for performance, compliance, and seamless integration.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Define and own IAM Solutions: You will lead the design, validation, and technical ownership of Identity & Access Management (IAM) solutions, whether for new implementations or evolutions of existing systems. You will ensure alignment with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and business needs.
• Produce and Maintain Architecture Documentation: You will create and update high-quality architecture deliverables, including blueprints, solution architecture and reference architecture documents. 
• Support and Mentor Other Architects: You will serve as the go-to IAM subject-matter expert, providing technical guidance, best practices, and mentorship to fellow architects, security teams, and project stakeholders. You will help clarify complex IAM concepts (e.g., federation, attribute-based access control, identity lifecycle management) and ensure solutions are secure, scalable, and user-friendly.
• Ensure Compliance and Mitigate Risks: You will guarantee that IAM architectures comply with internal policies and external regulations, collaborating with risk and compliance teams to address audit findings and mitigate.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• IAM Architecture Design: Deep expertise in designing and optimizing Identity & Access Management (IAM) frameworks, including authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management, aligned with enterprise security policies and compliance (e.g., GDPR, NIS2).
• Security-First Integration: Ability to architect secure, scalable IAM solutions that integrate seamlessly with enterprise systems (e.g., cloud platforms, legacy applications), leveraging zero-trust principles, federation protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OpenID Connect)
• Risk and Compliance Awareness: Strong understanding of IT security and cybersecurity risks (e.g., identity threats, credential abuse) and how to mitigate them through architectural controls, auditing, and least-privilege access models.
• Cross-Domain Collaboration: Proven ability to bridge technical IAM requirements with business needs, working closely with security teams, other Architects and stakeholders to ensure robust, user-friendly, and future-proof solutions
• You express yourself fluently in English, both orally and in writing, and have a basic knowledge of Dutch or French
• Identity & Access Management (IAM) Security: Expertise in ISVA (IBM Security Verify Access), API Gateways and WAF.
• Authentication & Encryption: Strong knowledge of oAuth2, TLS, and related security protocols.
• Security-First Mindset: Proven ability to integrate security as a foundational element in enterprise architecture.

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong R&D background in memory and/or storage subsystem architecture or design in a larger compute system, with relevant academic/industry experience. What you will do
 
 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in applications, technology, circuits and design (across imec) towards R&D of novel memory/storage solutions in a system.

Who you are

• You have familiarity and/or experience with memory/storage technology innovations and/or memory interfaces/controllers and/or compute-near-memory/storage engines.

As an Automation Engineer in the IT Agile Production Services (TechEx) tribe, you will design, implement, and optimize automated solutions to enhance the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our mission-critical IT infrastructure.

We are seeking an experienced Automation Engineer to join our team, with responsibility for automating IT Operations processes using technologies such as Ansible, GitLab, GitLab CI, and Terraform. The ideal candidate will bring a strong automation background, excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with IT Operations teams.

You will join a dynamic team of 20+ subject matter experts based at our Brussels HQ (Montagne du Parc), where innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence drive our mission to deliver seamless banking experiences.

If you are motivated by the opportunity to work in a large-scale IT environment, coordinate international initiatives, and support our most critical banking systems, we would welcome your application.

 

Technology Referent – more detailed responsibilities

• Design, build, and deploy end-to-end automation solutions for IT Operations processes, covering DevOps, Security, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and GitOps.
• Partner with IT Operations teams to assess automation needs, identify optimization opportunities, and define project priorities.
• Develop and maintain automation scripts and workflows using Ansible, GitLab CI, and other relevant tools.
• Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to ensure scalable and consistent environments.
• Ensure quality and reliability by rigorously testing, validating, and documenting automation solutions.
• Diagnose and resolve automation-related issues to maintain operational efficiency.
• Contribute to the definition of automation standards, best practices, and governance frameworks.
• Align automation initiatives with organizational goals by collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Your talent and competencies

Technical Expertise:

• Proven experience with automation tools: Ansible, GitLab CI, and Terraform.
• Deep understanding of DevOps, Security, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and GitOps principles.
• Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure (cloud environments), monitoring tools (e.g., Dynatrace), and Incident/Problem Management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow) – prior expertise required.
• Hands-on experience in automation (3+ years), preferably in IT Operations or SRE environments.
Problem-Solving & Operational Excellence:

• Results-driven mindset with the ability to anticipate operational risks and implement proactive, scalable solutions.
• Analytical and detail-oriented, with a focus on system reliability, observability, and operational quality.
• Adaptability in fast-paced environments, balancing changing priorities while maintaining high standards.
Collaboration & Communication:

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, bridging technical expertise with stakeholder alignment on reliability and efficiency goals.
• Fluent English (C1) and proficiency in French or Dutch (B2) to engage effectively with local and international teams.
• Ownership and accountability, taking initiative to resolve complex technical challenges while ensuring client-centric outcomes.
Education & Continuous Learning:

• Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, with a focus on operational resilience, automation, or system engineering.
• Passion for staying ahead of industry trends in automation and IT resilience, with a growth mindset and eagerness to learn.

jobs.occupation: Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Specialist | HQ
jobs.description:
Offering innovative hearing solutions to enable our customers to enjoy life to the fullest - that's our ambition. As number one on the Belgian market, we are constantly looking for talented and enthusiastic new colleagues.  Working at Sonova Retail Belgium means working in a company which is part of the world's leading manufacturer of hearing solutions, the Sonova Group. In more than 90 countries, our hearing solutions improve people's lives. A career with us has therefore no limits!

 

Your responsibilities as Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Specialist:

As Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Specialist, you are a key partner for the business, hiring managers and HR. You ensure a smooth and professional recruitment process while proactively building talent pipelines and strengthening our employer brand within the audiological and retail market.

You will be responsible for:
 
• Managing the end-to-end recruitment process from intake to onboarding: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate communication, selection support, offer follow-up and handover. 
• Partnering with hiring managers and the HR Business Partner to analyze recruitment needs and translate them into clear profiles and hiring strategies. 
• Developing and executing effective sourcing strategies via LinkedIn, job boards, social media, referrals, schools, universities and recruitment partners. 
• Building and maintaining talent pipelines and a structured talent community, with a focus on audiological profiles, retail talent and hard-to-fill positions, through proactive sourcing, hunting and talent pooling. 
• Nurturing relationships with potential candidates and engaging talent pools through targeted communication initiatives (e.g. newsletters and employer branding content). 
• Ensuring a positive, consistent and professional candidate experience throughout the entire recruitment process. 
• Coordinating audiology internships by aligning business needs, matching students with placements and ensuring follow-up with interns, supervisors and educational partners, including evaluations and feedback moments. 
• Supporting and strengthening campus recruitment initiatives through partnerships with schools and universities, student engagement and participation in events. 
• Coordinating student jobs by aligning with business needs and managing contacts with students and interim agencies, ensuring smooth planning, administration and onboarding. 
• Developing and maintaining strong partnerships with schools, universities, training institutes and external recruitment partners. 
• Planning and participating in recruitment events such as job fairs, campus events, presentations, speeddates and networking initiatives. 
• Contributing to employer branding and recruitment marketing by creating and coordinating engaging content across different channels in collaboration with HR, Marketing and Communications. 
• Monitoring recruitment performance and KPIs, analyzing results and continuously improving recruitment and sourcing strategies. 
• Acting as a true Sonova/Lapperre ambassador towards candidates and external partners. 

To be successful in this role, you will need:
 
• A master's degree in HR, Communication, Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent through experience. 
• Min. 5 years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, employer branding or recruitment marketing. 
• Experience with end-to-end recruitment and proactive sourcing techniques. 
• Affinity with campus recruitment, internships or collaboration with schools and universities is a strong asset. 
• Fluency in Dutch, French and English. 
• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple processes and stakeholders simultaneously. 
• A proactive and hands-on mindset combined with creativity and strong communication skills. 
• Experience with LinkedIn, social media and recruitment tools. 
• A people-oriented, curious and positive attitude, with a strong team spirit and sense of ownership.

jobs.occupation: Senior Digital Transformation Architect - Transportation sector
jobs.description:
Digital transformation is the cornerstone of Sopra Steria’s commitment to innovation and collaboration. It’s what brings businesses up to the present and secures them for the future. It’s how we align our tech and business goals to keep pace with emerging tech trends and best practices. To do so, you’ll need a forward-thinking, long-view, adaptable mindset to go with your problem solving and analytical skills. Proficiency in cloud computing, data analytics, cybersecurity, and AI skills all help us to collaborate in the business ecosystem to manage digital projects and make adoption of new tech simple and beneficial.

Our Architects have the vision and leadership skills to make daring IT decisions that can make digital transformation a reality. Your ability to collaborate across teams and departments and your flexibility to adopt new technologies will help you enhance system performance, scalability, and security. Fulfil your software vision at Sopra Steria and align it with our business development goals. As a Sopra Steria Architect, you’ll have successful projects in your portfolio that can demonstrate your excellent problem-solving skills and commitment to continuous learning.

Small context :

From the start, you will be immersed in our company culture and way of working, understanding all the capabilities we use to serve our clients in their digital transformation journey. You will work closely with the Sopra Steria teams to provide strategic architectural guidance that helps our transportation clients navigate their transition challenges across the digital themes mentioned above.

Your role as Senior Digital Transformation Architect – Transportation "required" :

• You understand like no other the architectural landscape and digital challenges of our transportation customers. Moreover, you are capable and driven to help them design and implement transformative digital solutions while actively growing our advisory agency.
• You master core business processes in the transportation market and can seamlessly bridge the gap between business needs and technological solutions. You will:
• Design and architect digital transformation initiatives for railway and public transportation operators
• Lead business framing and solution architecture for key digital themes such as: Transformation Consulting, Cybersecurity, Data, Applications & Integrations, Cloud & Infrastructure
• Develop enterprise architecture blueprints that align IT direction with business objectives
• Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Transportation sector, with a focus on digital transformation.
• You will be encouraged and expected to bring innovative architectural thinking, challenge the status quo, and drive growth, both with our customers and within Sopra Steria.
 

Your profile as Senior Digital Transformation Architect – Transportation "required" :

• Higher degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• 10+ years of IT architecture experience, with 5+ years in digital transformation for the Transportation sector "REQUIRED".
• Proven track record in large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital themes (Transformation Consulting, Cybersecurity, Data, Applications & Integrations, Cloud & Infrastructure).
• Fluent in French and English – Dutch is a plus
• Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to bridge business strategy and technical implementation.
• Passion for innovative technology solutions in transportation.
• 
Entrepreneurial spirit with a focus on growth and business development

The sky’s the limit with cloud computing, so you’ll need to use skills of virtualization, containerization, and orchestration using tools like Kubernetes and Docker to design, deploy, and manage cloud-based solutions. We pride ourselves on our secure, compliant, efficient and well-optimized cloud solutions. You’ll feel at home working with cloud-native development, serverless architectures, and DevOps practices.
